first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person walking along the bridge with their back to the camera, wearing a brown pointed wide-brimmed hat, with a long light-brown braid hanging down their back, and dressed in gray-green long sleeves, a dark vest, and a dark-brown long skirt.

entities.name: Layered Rocky Hills
entities.identification: A rocky hill behind the far end of the bridge, with step-like rock strata and protruding rock ledges.

entities.name: Blue Sky and White Clouds
entities.identification: The pale cyan-blue sky and large expanses of white clouds in the upper part of the frame, brighter in the upper right.

entities.name: Tall Grass by the Bridge and Vegetation on the Grassy Slope
entities.identification: Green clumps of grass beside the bridge and on the slope on the right, with the foreground containing long, slender blades, grass stems, and pale seed heads.

entities.name: Distant Flat-Topped Mountain
entities.identification: A blue-gray flat-topped mountain in the distant background in the upper left of the frame, with steep sidewalls and a silhouette softened by mist.

entities.name: Gray-Blue Stone-Slab Bridge Deck
entities.identification: A gray-blue stone-paved passage converging toward the far end between the stone railings on both sides.

entities.name: Reddish-Brown Stone Railings on Both Sides of the Bridge
entities.identification: Low reddish-brown stone railings on both sides of the bridge; the repeating arched openings in the left railing are clear, and the nearby stones have moss on them.

entities.name: Dark Boulder on the Right
entities.identification: A large, angular, dark-gray to nearly black rock on the slope on the right, with a brighter rock face on its right side.

entities.name: Rocky Slope on the Right
entities.identification: A gray-green rocky slope descending steeply on the right side of the bridge, with inclined bedding and dark fissures on the exposed rock surfaces.

entities.name: Blue-Gray Water Surface on the Left
entities.identification: A partially exposed horizontal band of blue-gray water outside the stone railing on the left, with pale reflective streaks.

entities.name: Canyon Rock Wall on the Left
entities.identification: A tall rock wall behind the water surface on the left, fading into blue-gray mist.

entities.name: Tall Tree and Small Tree atop the Rocky Hill
entities.identification: One tall tree atop the central rocky hill and the small tree to its image-left, recorded as the same background group of trees.
